name: Dear Clara
detailed_description:
A Time-Hopping Adventure Across Generational Timelines.

On the 19th of January 1989, Clara receives a brief from the future.

"Dear Clara

If you are reading this, I can only hope the record has arrived intact.

         You may find this impossible to believe, but it is of upmost importance you take what I am about to say at face value, as the content of this mission may change the course of history. For starters, if all is correct, I believe the year should fall on ____. I hope that helps to prove my case.

         You will soon live a life full of wonder and adventure until the age where ones mind begins to settle. It is at that singular point in time, new technology will be invented - The power to send data back in time. I am finally coming to terms with my time on earth, grateful to have lived beyond my age. There is however, only one regret I have. A lingering mistake that has kept with me for years. Our legacy is etched in this book, if the possibilities are still there, I hope you can remedy my foolishness. You will know when it happens.

I wish you luck,

C.H"

Explore the day the event was written.

  • Time travel between different days to crossmatch evidence.

  • Deduce answers from clues scatter within the shared history of the house.

Solve a incomplete timeline.

  • Reconstruct the Legacy Record, a collection of generational diaries with missing information.

  • Gain a perspective on the narrative with each solve.

Inspect, think and re-inspect.

  • Not every clue is what it seems — take your time and take a closer look at every item in the house.

  • Inspect items from any angle to ensure no evidence is left behind.

Listen to Memory Echos from the past.

  • Audio remains of unique characters are waiting to be heard and dissected.

  • Connect the missing dots to uncover the bigger story.

Content Warning: This game demo explores themes of significant personal loss and intense grief that some may find distressing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or higher) or Windows 11.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible with at least 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
